summary: Session 3 of 4 (Security/catalog registration generator). Adds tools/Dabbler.CrudSlice/RegistrationReferenceEmitter.cs which renders a {Entity}Registrations.g.cs reference file containing four clearly-commented copy-paste blocks (API entity, API endpoints, Web page, Web endpoints) that the consumer pastes into their AddDabblerSecurity(...) lambdas in Api/Program.cs and Web/Program.cs. The block shapes match the host's real Supplier wiring at Api/Program.cs:94-103 (entity), :135-139 (endpoints), Web/Program.cs:155-162 (entity/pages) and :189-194 (endpoints), including the pre-existing host-side identifier drift (Api uses singular Query{Entity}/Get{Entity}; Web uses plural/ById Query{EntityPlural}/Get{Entity}ById). Block shapes live as .template files under tools/Dabbler.CrudSlice/Templates/ (ApiEntityBlock, EntityFieldRow, ApiEndpointBlock, WebPageBlock, WebEndpointBlock) loaded as embedded resources via <EmbeddedResource Include="Templates\*.template" /> and applied via a {{Placeholder}}-substitution helper inside the emitter. The whole emitted file body is wrapped in #if false / #endif so the reference never compiles even if accidentally included in a csproj compile glob (the wrapper does NOT edit Program.cs per anti-pattern #1). Added --emit-registrations CLI alias (no-op opt-in for default-on emit) + --skip-registrations opt-out. Tests: tests/Dabbler.CrudSlice.Tests/RegistrationReferenceEmitterTests.cs adds 14 facts (4 block-header presence, #if false fence, Api/Web per-side endpoint shape assertions, page-block shape, lowercased plural paths, both-endpoint-blocks emit, empty-schema valid emit, header-documents-shape-source-line-ranges, PrettifyCamelCase parameterized cases, LoadSchemaOrEmpty missing/unparseable tolerance). WrapperOrchestrationTests.Skip_registrations_flag_suppresses_reference_file_emit added; EmitRegistrationsOnly + FullPipeline tests extended to verify the new reference file. Web/Program.cs:103 duplicate /suppliers page registration removed (Web/Program.cs:101 retained as canonical). Build green; 984 tests pass (978 non-Playwright + 6 Testing.Blazor), 2 skipped (PackagingSmoke gated on pack-output), 0 failed. 3 verification rounds via gpt-5-4 ($0.1457 + $0.0417 + $0.0192 = $0.2066): Round 1 ISSUES_FOUND (Major endpoint-shape gap + Minor CLI shape + Minor Templates/ placement); Round 2 Major fixed accepted, Minor 2(a) accepted, Minor 2(b) maintained; human adjudicated to accept verifier finding on 2(b) — Templates/ extraction landed before Round 3 VERIFIED. Plus $0.0036 routed gemini-pro Session 4 orchestrator recommendation. Session total: ~$0.21.
